item.title: Help with Reviews & Greenlight
item.content:encoded:
Hello, so normally I may let it ago but I was told to reach out to staff about this: I have an SCP idea I really do believe in, an anomalous location I think could be expanded into lots of things. Problem is no ones looked at it, contacted some reviewers and heard nothing back. I would say I was being patient since I didn’t think of doing more until I was notified how afar it dropped. If anyone has advice or ways to move forward I’d appreciate it, thanks!

this is the scp: http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13886686/the-abyss-is-safe-seeking-crits-and-greenlight#post-4830879
